page.layout: One column of text, full width, with a running head at the top and a signature at the foot. The text is a declension table in roman type with German glosses in black letter, followed by two italic lines of a question.

main_text.head: Pluralis Numerus.
main_text.l: N. Hi, hæ, hæc, die/ in allem geschlecht. G.Horum, harum,horum,derer. D.His,denen. A. Hos,has,hæc, die. A.Ab his,von denen.
main_text.head: Singularis Numerus.
main_text.l: N. Is, der oder er. Ea,die oder sie. Id,das. G.Ejus, des oder sein/der/des. D.Ei, dem oder im/der/dem.
A. Eum,den oder jn. Eam,die oder sie. Id,das. A.Ab eo, von dem/oder jm. Ab ea,von der oder jr. Ab eo,von dem.
main_text.head: Pluralis Numerus.
main_text.l: N.Ei,vel ii,eæ,ea,die oder sie. G.Eorum,earum,eorum,derer. D.Eis vel iis,denen. A.Eos,eas,ea,die oder sie. A.Ab eis vel iis,von denen. Sic idem,eadem,idem, ejuldem,&c.
main_text.head: Singularis Numerus.
main_text.l: N. Quis,wer/ qui,welcher. Quæ vel qua,welche/ quid,was/.quod, welches. G. Cujus,welches oder wes/welcher/welches. D. Cui, welchem oder wem/welcher/welchem. A. Quem, welchen oder wen/quâ, welche / quid ,was/ quod welches. A.aquo,von welchem oder wem / à qua , von welcher / a quo,von welchem. Aliquando Qui in omni genere.
main_text.head: Pluralis Numerus.
main_text.l: N Qui,quæ,quæ vel qua,welche. G.Quorum,quarum,quorum,welcher. D. Queis vel quibus, welche. A. Quos,quas, quæ vel qua,welche. A queis vel quibus,von welchen. Hinc nascuntur regularia: Cujus, cuja,cujum. welches/ cujas,cujatis, welches landes/ oder glaubens/oder anhangs.

page.notes: The German glosses are set in black letter and are marked as such. The "d 4" at the foot is a gathering signature. The word "jn" in the accusative gloss is printed that way and is read as printed. No marginal notes are present. The text is clear throughout, and no words are doubtful.
